<tool_call>

<parameter=code>
def dots_all(fr):
    a=fr.ascii.split('\n'); out=[]
    # scan top box rows 9-27 cols 7-46, bottom box rows 41-57 cols 41-54
    for (r0,r1,c0,c1) in [(9,27,7,46),(41,57,41,54)]:
        pts=set()
        for r in range(r0,r1):
            for c2 in range(c0,c1):
                if a[r][c2] in ('N','g','G'): pts.add((r,c2))
        seen=set()
        for p in pts:
            if p in seen: continue
            st=[p]; comp=[]
            while st:
                q=st.pop()
                if q in seen or q not in pts: continue
                seen.add(q); comp.append(q); r,cc=q
                for dr,dc in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    if (r+dr,cc+dc) in pts: st.append((r+dr,cc+dc))
            out.append((min(x[0] for x in comp),min(x[1] for x in comp),len(comp)))
    return sorted(out)
print("start:", dots_all(current_frame))
